subject: Pipeline hygiene: week-of action on pending discounts impacting committed forecast
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sales Leadership <sales-leads@redwood.com>; Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: week-of action on pending discounts impacting committed forecast

Team — quick housekeeping for the week: I pulled the commit rollup and there are five deals currently marked as "Commit" in HubSpot that have outstanding discount approvals or draft redlines. If these concessions are approved as-is they will materially reduce our committed ARR for Nov/Dec and will change the Q4 commit mix.

Ask (short list):
- Sales: please reconfirm stage + expected close date in HubSpot by EOD Tue. Use the attached week44_commit_rollup.xlsx.
- Deal Desk: prioritize triage for the two >$100k ARR deals (GreenWave & ProcureCorp). We need an explicit approval or an alternate price (no higher than currently requested) by Wed COB.
- Finance: please flag any deals that should be treated as "at-risk" in the forecast if approval goes through as requested.

Impact summary (seen in rollup):
- GreenWave Energy (deal 54321): requested 30% discount on first-year usage; delta approx $200k ARR if approved.
- ProcureCorp (deal 54890): multi-year term + onboarding concession request; delta approx $120k ARR.

If we don't get final deal desk responses by Wed, we'll treat those line items as downside to the committed forecast in the weekly rollup. I'm looping Vanessa and Ben because they own the territory and contract cadence.

Attachments: week44_commit_rollup.xlsx (spreadsheet with deal rows), quick link to the HubSpot deals above.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Account Executive, North America
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Sales Leadership <sales-leads@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.com>

If these concessions are approved as-is they will materially reduce our committed ARR for Nov/Dec and will change the Q4 commit mix.

Thanks for the heads-up, Soojin. I'm putting GreenWave and ProcureCorp at the top of my queue.

Vanessa plan: I'll coordinate with Ben to get the final technical/POC notes into the Google Drive and ping Marissa/Karthik for an expedited review. We need the deal-specific rationale (business case + TCV breakout) in one place.

Ben — can you confirm whether GreenWave is insisting on the 30% discount because of usage volume or because of a competitive carveout? That will steer our payable credits vs. price reduction approach.

I'll update the HubSpot stage comments as we get answers.

- Vanessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: week-of action on pending discounts impacting committed forecast

Thanks Vanessa / Soojin — looping in Deal Desk ops to triage. A couple of quick clarifying asks before we can expedite: 
1) For each deal, please upload the discount rationale PDF (customer justification, competitive situation, and ROI slide if available). I need the documents for audit.
2) Provide the exact ARR and how you calculated the delta (list line items: base license, overage, onboarding credits).
3) Confirm whether the requested pricing is limited to year 1 or intended to reprice renewals.

If you can get those into the drive by EOD today I can commit to reviewing GreenWave first thing tomorrow morning and giving a yes/no + alternate concession. If not, we'll need to calendar a 30-min triage call.

Karthik Iyer
Lead, Deal Desk Pricing & Approvals
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: week-of action on pending discounts impacting committed forecast

Folks — quick update from Deal Desk after review:

GreenWave (deal 54321): approved a limited 25% first-year usage discount (reduced from 30%) with a mandatory quarterly usage review clause. We will treat the onboarding credit as one-time non-recurring; total first-year ARR impact = ~$170,000. Attached: GreenWave_approval_redline.pdf and discount_rationale_greenwave.pdf.

ProcureCorp (deal 54890): we deferred full approval — approved a capped onboarding credit but denied the multi-year price protection; sales to return with a revised commercial (Ben/Vanessa). If sales proceeds without a revised price, Finance should treat the current commit row as downside exposure of ~$120,000 ARR.

Action items: 
- Sales (Soojin/Vanessa/Ben): Update HubSpot comments on both deals to reflect approved concession (GreenWave) and "pending pricing" status (ProcureCorp).
- Finance Ops: please mark GreenWave as "committed (adjusted)" for week 44 with -$170,000 ARR and mark ProcureCorp as "at-risk" (-$120,000) pending final commercial. We'll re-run the rollup once sales confirms the revised ProcureCorp commercial.

I'll close the GreenWave approval in DocuSign and drop the executed summary in the drive. If Finance wants an extra sign-off or a GL code for tracking the onboarding credit, ping me and I'll assign a tracker.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
